question.text: The dipeptide, Gln-Gly, on treatment with $\mathrm{CH}_3 \mathrm{COCl}$ followed by aqueous work up gives.

solution.text:
Amino group of glutamine is acetylated. Amide group of glutamine is not acetylated. Note :
Acetylation of amide requires activation of amides and /or acyl donors, since the nitrogen atom of amides is less basic than that of the corresponding amines due to amide resonance.
